summary: Linear membership scan of a static 16-bit table starting at unk_5E7204 and bounded by off_5E7218 (exclusive). Returns 0 when the 16-bit argument a1 matches a table word, and 1 after the pointer walks past the end bound. Used as a range/validity check by LocaleEnumProc (0x0058FFEC) and sub_59033A (0x0059033A).

local_names.a1: 16-bit value tested for membership in the static table
local_names.v1: walking pointer over the static word table, initialized to unk_5E7204

operations.description: Start of scan: v1 = &unk_5E7204, the base of the static 16-bit table
while (a1 != *v1) advance v1 one word at a time, comparing the argument against each table entry
When the incremented pointer passes &off_5E7218 (the table end bound), the value is not present and the function returns 1
Returns 0 when a match is found (a1 equals a table word); returns 1 when the scan exits past the end bound
Called by LocaleEnumProc (0x0058FFEC) and by sub_59033A (0x0059033A) to filter a 16-bit value against the static range table

unresolved: The meaning of the table words between unk_5E7204 and off_5E7218 is unknown; only the bound addresses are evidenced, not the intended value domain
The semantics of the return code (0 = present) relative to the callers' expectations is unproven here
off_5E7218 is named as a pointer but the decompiler treats table elements as 16-bit words; whether the endpoint is itself a member of the data is ambiguous
